en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large neoclassical judicial building with three stories and a central domed pavilion topped by a flag. The foreground has an open, partially undeveloped area with paths, stacked materials and some trees. Printed captions in red identify the location and publisher, and there is handwritten German text across the lower half and date at the top right.
